ticker: Consequent Cabinet's decision, Master Plan Department was separated from SBCA and established as separate Sindh Master Plan Authority vide Letter

Merger of Town Planning Department Hyderabad into SMPA, Department of Town Planning, Government of Sindh, having mandate of master planning of the overall districts of the Sindh (except Karachi division), merged into Sindh Master Plan Authority vide LG&HTP Department's Notification SO(G)/HTP/SBCA/7-63/2018 Dated 14-09-2020

vision_mission.tagline: Empowering Sindh's Urban Landscape for Sustainable Development and Dynamic Economic Growth
vision_mission.intro: At SMPA, we aim to provide long and short-term plans, strategies and framework to transform the cities of Sindh into self-sufficient, sustainable and resilient cities, holding viable and improving economy, providing aesthetic recreational and public spaces, promoting diversity and ecological balance, preserving culture and environment.
vision_mission.vision: Empowering Sustainable Progress: Transforming Sindh into a model of inclusive, resilient, and harmoniously developed communities through comprehensive planning and strategic implementation.
vision_mission.mission: At Sindh Master Plan Authority, our mission is to lead the way in fostering holistic and equitable development across Sindh, driven by innovative urban planning, robust infrastructure, and environmental stewardship. We strive to collaborate with diverse stakeholders, leverage cutting-edge technologies, and prioritize the needs of our communities to create a vibrant, progressive, and sustainable province for generations to come.

legal_note: These Master Plans and Land-use Plans, presented here, are sole property of Master Plan Department and may be used only for research and study purpose. Editing, tempering, forgery and fabrication shall be liable for legal action.
